subject: SOC 2 addendum + confirm audit coverage window
messages:
From: Helen Zhao <helen.zhao@healthcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: HealthCorp Procurement <procurement@healthcorp.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for latest SOC 2 Type II report and addendum on audit window

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well. We’re finalizing Redwood on our security review for an upcoming pilot. Two quick asks so we can close procurement: 

1) Can you share the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) you have available? Our info-sec team flagged that the copy in the vendor portal references an audit period ending 2027-04-30 and shows an expiration/coverage gap when we compare to other vendors.

2) If there’s a bridge letter or addendum that confirms coverage between the last report and the current quarter (or a reissued package), could you attach that and call out the exact audit window covered? We need the dates spelled out to confirm continuous coverage for our regulatory checklist.

If you have an evidence index or an index of attachments, please include that too. We can treat the docshare link as technical delivery.

Thanks — we’re hoping to finish this by Friday.

Best,
Helen Zhao
Senior InfoSec Manager
HealthCorp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Helen Zhao <helen.zhao@healthcorp.com>
Cc: karthik@redwood.com, sean@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest SOC 2 Type II report and addendum on audit window

Hi Helen — thanks for the note and the clear ask.

Short answer: yes, I can share the current Type II and a bridge letter that explains the audit coverage window. There was a reissue conversation with our auditor in May which created a slightly different filename/version in the portal — that’s likely what triggered the mismatch you saw.

I’m attaching the following to this thread for convenience:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027-05-01.pdf (final reissued report)
- Redwood_SOC2_Bridge_Letter_2027-05-01_to_2027-08-31.pdf (confirming continuous coverage until our next audit completes)
- SOC2_Evidence_Index_2027-05.xlsx (high-level index — redactions applied where required)

Key point to call out here: the auditor reissued the Type II on 2027-05-01 to include a clarifying addendum; while an earlier portal copy showed the initial report date (2027-04-20), the reissued package supersedes that. The bridge letter explicitly confirms the audit window through 2027-08-31 while our next engagement is scheduled.

Karthik is on copy if you need any technical notes about scope (particularly data residency and private deployment controls), and Sean is looped for procurement/compliance escalation if HealthCorp needs a signed attestation.

I’ll upload the same package to the drive link in my signature. Let me know if you want a short call to walk the report.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027-05-01.pdf; Redwood_SOC2_Bridge_Letter_2027-05-01_to_2027-08-31.pdf; SOC2_Evidence_Index_2027-05.xlsx

From: Helen Zhao <helen.zhao@healthcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: HealthCorp Procurement <procurement@healthcorp.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest SOC 2 Type II report and addendum on audit window

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the quick turnaround and the context. A couple follow-ups after scanning the PDFs: 

• The bridge letter refers to a reissue on 2027-05-01 but the cover page on the PDF still has the original report ID. Can you confirm the canonical report ID you want us to reference in our procurement docs?

• Our InfoSec lead wants to confirm that the reissued report does not change the control conclusions — only clarifies the audit period metadata. Is that accurate? If so, can the auditor statement be highlighted or can you share the auditor contact line so we can verify?

• Any chance we could get a signed/dated attestation from Redwood (one page) to include in our packet to legal? Short note confirming the reissue is clarifying-only and the bridge letter extends coverage to 2027-08-31.

If it helps, we can set a 20-minute call with our InfoSec on Thursday. Procurement target remains EOW.

Best,
Helen

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Helen Zhao <helen.zhao@healthcorp.com>
Cc: karthik@redwood.com, sean@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest SOC 2 Type II report and addendum on audit window

Hi Helen — quick responses inline and next steps below.

1) Canonical report ID: Please reference RED-SOC2-2027-05v1 in your procurement artifacts. The file you saw with the older filename is an earlier export; RED-SOC2-2027-05v1 is the reissued identifier and is the authoritative one.

2) Control conclusions: Correct — the reissue contained clarifying language only and did not modify control opinions or testing results. I’ve pulled the auditor confirmation paragraph and highlighted it on page 3 of the PDF (see attachment note). If you’d like direct verification, our auditor contact is Claire Mendoza, Partner at Silvergate Audit (claire.mendoza@silvergateaudit.com).

3) Attestation: Attached — Redwood_Signed_Attestation_SOC2_2027-07-01.pdf. It’s a one-page signed confirmation from our Trust Officer that the reissue is metadata/clarifying-only and the bridge letter extends coverage through 2027-08-31.

Next steps: I’ll upload the same four files to the shared drive link and send a short DocuSign if HealthCorp requires a countersigned delivery receipt. If you want the 20-minute call, Sean can be available Thursday 11:00-11:30 PT to answer procurement questions.

Thanks again — glad we could clear up the naming/version confusion quickly.

—
